_readme: Edit, save, then restart the service (see README). Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_accounts: Sign-in settings. admin_email is created automatically as Admin + Planner. Everyone starts with default_password and must change it at first sign-in.
_restrict_to_own_mcs: true = buyers and category heads only see requests on their own MCs (from the SCR products file) plus their own requests.
_cookie_secure: Set to true once the site is served over https:// (see README section 6).
_backups: Nightly copy of the data folder, after backup_hour (24h clock), kept backup_keep_days days.
_history_retention_days: 0 = keep all history forever (every upload version, Tool 2 run and Tool 1 request). Set e.g. 365 to delete history older than a year (the current files are never deleted).
_ai: One anthropic_api_key turns on BOTH the AI chat assistant and AI Insights. A groq_api_key is optional - if set, AI Insights uses Groq instead. The VM needs outbound HTTPS to api.anthropic.com (and api.groq.com if used), or set outbound_proxy, e.g. http://proxy.company.local:8080. After editing, run test-ai.bat, then restart-service.ps1.
